title: Microstructure and strengthening mechanisms of novel lightweight TiAlV0.5CrMo refractory high-entropy alloy fabricated by mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering
process_description: prepared by high-energy ball milling using elemental powders Ti, Al, V, Cr, and Mo with high purity (> 99.9 wt%) for 30 h with a ball to powder weight ratio of 30:1 at 400 rpm under argon atmosphere. The powders were then consolidated by spark plasma sintering at 1100, 1200, 1300 °C for 5 min under an axial pressure of 50 MPa with a heating rate of 100 °C/min.
